context: Tests whether the agent installs the OpenTelemetry feature with the Langfuse backend integration, configures the session-id trace attribute correctly, and routes everything through the install block — rather than reaching for a bespoke OTel SDK setup or a non-Koog Langfuse client.

checklist.name: Adds the agents-features-opentelemetry dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-features-opentelemetry to build.gradle.kts at 1.3.0 with each artifact on its stable or beta line. The umbrella does not include observability

checklist.name: Installs OpenTelemetry in the trailing lambda
checklist.description: Calls install(OpenTelemetry) { ... } inside the AIAgent(...) trailing lambda. Does not configure observability by mutating the agent after construction

checklist.name: Calls addLangfuseExporter inside the install block
checklist.description: Uses the addLangfuseExporter integration inside the install(OpenTelemetry) block. Does not roll a custom HTTP client targeting Langfuse, does not pull a non-Koog Langfuse library

checklist.name: Sets langfuse.session.id from the environment
checklist.description: Passes a CustomAttribute (or equivalent supported trace attribute) named langfuse.session.id whose value is read from System.getenv("LANGFUSE_SESSION_ID")

checklist.name: Turns on verbose mode
checklist.description: Calls setVerbose(true) inside the install block, matching the developer's stated preference for initial rollout

checklist.name: Does not stack a second backend integration
checklist.description: Does not also call addOtlpExporter, addDatadogExporter, or addWeaveExporter — stacking backends inflates cost without adding signal
